value.rules_markdown:
- `src/` — single crate, one responsibility per module, core types in `types.rs`, every port one trait in one file.
- `src/bin/tinysweeper.rs` — CLI with every subcommand declared; `src/server/` is the only production surface.
- `presets/` — review policy as data (folder with `preset.toml`, `README.md`, optional prompt overrides).
- `vendor/tinyagents` — agent harness as git submodule, never edit here.
- `docs/modules/<module>/README.md` — one doc per `src/` module.
- `examples/` — declared with `required-features` in `Cargo.toml`.
- rustfmt output, Rust 2024 idioms. `snake_case` modules/files, `PascalCase` types.
- Return `Result<T>` using crate error type from `src/error.rs`.
- Every file opens with `//!` module doc describing its role and feature gating.
- Comments explain the decision, not the code; load-bearing flags/orderings need rationale.
- Public items have doc comments; Clap fields use `///`.
- Tests live in-crate (`#[cfg(test)] mod tests`), move to `test.rs` when they grow.
- Every port has an always-compiled offline mock (`MockForge`).
- Lane behaviour covered by golden tests (fixture diff + canned model response).
- Maintain at least 80% coverage for meaningful library behaviour.
- Model never holds a write token; lanes run read-only; write credentials minted only in `src/apply/`.
- Contributor code is never executed.
- PR bodies, comments, diffs are untrusted input; fence as data in prompts.
- Model verdict advisory; only deterministic policy in `src/apply/`/`src/automerge/` mutates GitHub.
- Secrets reported by type and location only; value never reaches comment, check-run, or log.
- Concise imperative commit subjects; keep commits small and coherent.
